text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Concomitant use of naproxen and lithium can lead to elevated plasma lithium levels and reduced renal lithium clearance [naproxen:drug_interactions:7]. This interaction occurs because NSAIDs inhibit renal prostaglandin synthesis [naproxen:drug_interactions:7]. Consequently, patients taking this combination are at risk for lithium toxicity and should be monitored accordingly [naproxen:drug_interactions:7].
